items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I've never been very good at that kind of thing--- I always considered what I played modern Dixie-land and Swing... it wa only on one occasion that I got with a band that played George Lewis style

ctx.x: Right. Is that strictly New Orleans stuff?

Oh, sure. You know, it's a George Lewis type of music; I've never been very good at that kind of thing--- I always considered what I played modern Dixie-land and Swing--- and I think Swing is what I like better.
And, if they choose to call it Chicago style jazz - why that's their business---
